item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We believe that future is within reach—and that it could free people to spend their lives on what matters most.

2. Work as a necessity can end. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We’re ready to imagine a future where everyone has the freedom to choose how they spend their time.

3. We believe superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will make work unnecessary for every human being. That’s a profound change. We should prepare now for a future where our lives are no longer defined by the need to earn a living.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We are approaching a future that could transform everyday life at its roots. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We believe this plainly and fully: the need to earn a living can end for everyone. That would mean more than new tools or faster services. It would mean a profound change in how we spend our time, care for one another, learn, create and contribute to our communities. We want to help make this future real—and help shape a society where everyone can share in its benefits. Now is the time to consider what life beyond compulsory work can become.
